title: JustAuth
description: Player authentication mod for Better than Adventure servers
body:
Simple player authentication mod for small Better than Adventure servers.

### For server hosters
1. Create a folder named **justauth** in your server folder

2. For each player you want to give access to, create a file with their username and put a password in there (mashing your keyboard for like 5 seconds is generally a good idea. make sure to not go above 127 characters)

3. Copy this file, rename it to **just.auth** and share it with your friend

### For players
1. Your host will give you a file named **just.auth**, put it in your **.minecraft** folder


Tested on 7.3_03 but it's probably compatible with a whole bunch of other versions too!
